help chat
HelpChat · the chat

DUMB VERSION
  Type words, press Enter, friends see them. @ pokes someone. \@ whispers.

WHAT IT IS
  The chat is the other side of this window (T opens it; Shift+T is the command line; the symbol beside the box switches). What you type there goes to everyone in the room.
  @name pings a player (a soft sound and a "!"), \@name sends privately, and the \ commands mute people or show what is muted.
  From the command line, `send` posts what a command prints to the chat, and `write` sends a private message.

HOW TO
  1. Press T and type a message; Enter sends it.
  2. Put @ and a name to ping someone: hi @name.
  3. Start with \@name to whisper: only they see it.
  4. From here: `send @everyone fortune` posts a command's answer.

FLAGS AND BASICS
  `@name / @everyone`
      pings a player / everyone
  `\@name message`
      a private message
  `\mute bubble ping text on @name`
      hides those from you until you leave (all: everything; off: undo)
  `\permmute …`
      the same, kept on this device (it asks first; -f skips that)
  `\show mute / permmute / players`
      what you muted, and who is here
  `\togglesuggest`
      the chat's suggestions on or off
  `\help / \clear`
      the chat's help / clears the chat on your screen
  `send @everyone <command>`
      from the command line: posts what the command prints
  `write @name message`
      from the command line: a private message

EXAMPLES
  chat> hi everyone, ready? @everyone
      pings the whole room
  chat> \@name psst, vote red
      only they see it
  chat> \mute bubble on @name
      hides their speech bubbles on the board
  chat> \show players
      who is in the room
  $ send @everyone ducksay good luck
      a duck wishes everyone luck
  $ roundstats | send @everyone
      a pipe into send
  $ write @name nice one
      a private message from here

SEE ALSO
  HelpGame-Send  HelpSilly  HelpGroups

help help
HelpHelp · how to get help

DUMB VERSION
  Type help. Pick a word from the list. Type that word. Repeat until smart.

WHAT IT IS
  `help` lists the Help pages. Each page is a command of its own: type HelpChat, HelpFile and so on. Capitals don't matter, and `help chat` opens the same page as HelpChat.
  Every page starts with a dumb version, then says what it is, how to do it, the flags and basics, and examples. Each example shows a different way of using it.
  For one command, `man` tells everything (`man sort`), and --help after a command tells it shortly. `man -k word` finds the commands that have to do with a word.
  Commands are colored by kind; `help` shows which color is which.

HOW TO
  1. Type `help` and find what you need in the list.
  2. Type the page's name: HelpGroups.
  3. Try the examples: type one exactly, then change a word of it.
  4. Stuck on one command? `man` and its name.

FLAGS AND BASICS
  `help`
      the list of Help pages and the colors
  `help <page>`
      a page (help groups is HelpGroups); help game how is HelpGame-How
  `help <command>`
      a command's manual page, if there is no page by that name
  `help all`
      every command, on a few lines
  `man -k word`
      the commands whose page says the word (apropos word too)
  `<command> --help`
      one command's help

EXAMPLES
  $ help
      the list
  $ HelpGroups
      a page, by its name
  $ help sudo
      the same as HelpSudo
  $ HelpGame-How
      one of HelpGame's own pages
  $ man -k file
      every command that has to do with files
  $ help | grep Game
      help is text like any other: grep finds lines in it

SEE ALSO
  HelpDescription  HelpMan  HelpBasics

man -k stat
cheat       - Dead Ducks Arcade jumps to round N (its zombies come in 3 seconds)
stat        - a file's size, permissions, group and when it changed.
tee         - writes what comes through | into files and passes it on (-a: adds to the end)
send        - posts the command's output to the chat (\@name: only to them); send @everyone cat file | grep duck sends what the whole pipe prints, and roundstats | send @everyone sends what comes through |
forgame     - the game's settings (anyone)
roundstats  - this round's stats (in Bicker Brackets the whole tournament), only for you to see
gamestats   - this game's stats
totalstats  - all-time stats (Hangout keeps none).

apropos room
env         - every variable: yours, and the game's (USER HOME PWD HOST ROOM MODE MAP ROUND STAGE PLAYERS RANDOM SHELL).
chmod       - -R (recursive) changes a folder and everything in it at once
setfacl     - what one player (a group, everyone) may do with one of your Seriat files or folders: r read it, w change it, x run it
getent      - a group's line, group:x:members:perms; with no group, every group in the room.
userdel     - ducks can't be deleted; kick @name removes one from the room.
who         - who is in the room, with the host and sudo marked.
w           - who is in the room and what they're doing: connection, away, and whether they have ended their turn.
users       - the names in the room on one line.
hostname    - the room's name
kick        - removes a player at once, no vote; they stay out until the room goes back to the lobby (the host, sudo, or a group with cankick).
song        - every song, on or off, and the one playing now (everyone in the room hears the same song at the same time)
\mute       - hides those from you until you leave the room
